ai.title: AI
ai.lede: How much the meeting agent and voice control are used this month, and who pays for it.
ai.guest: Only members can see the workspace's AI usage.
ai.loadFailed: Couldn't load the AI settings. Try again.
ai.readOnly: Only Owners and members with billing access can change this, because a key moves the cost of AI to the workspace's own account.

usage.resets: Pooled for the whole workspace. Resets {{date}}.
usage.spent: Used up. Where Kupro's hours run things, the microphone is off and typed text uses keyword matching. Resets {{date}}.
usage.noBudget: No hour limit on this server.
usage.ownHint: And {{tokens}} tokens of text. No hour limit: your provider bills the workspace directly.

unlimited.title: Want more than {{hours}} a month?
unlimited.body: Connect your own Scaleway key and use the meeting agent and voice control as much as you like. Scaleway bills your account directly. It takes about two minutes.

rejected.title: {{name}} rejected the workspace's key
rejected.body: The microphone is off, and typed text uses keyword matching. Kupro doesn't switch to its own key. Replace the key, or disconnect to go back to the included hours. Everyone with billing access got an email.

capabilityHint.transcription: Meeting audio, voice commands and dictation
capabilityHint.meetingProposals: Turns what was said in a meeting into issue changes

connection.untestedHint: {{model}} isn't the model Kupro tested. Check its proposals in suggest mode before you turn on full auto.
connection.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect {{name}}? The key is deleted, and what runs on it goes back to Kupro's included hours.

wizard.label: Connect your own key
wizard.guideIntro: You need a Scaleway account. Kupro never sees your Scaleway login.
wizard.guide1: In the Scaleway console, open IAM, then API keys, and choose Generate API key.
wizard.guide2: As the bearer, choose An application, and create one called Kupro.
wizard.guide3: Give the application a policy with access to Generative APIs in your project.
wizard.guide4: Copy the secret key. Scaleway shows it only once.
wizard.secretKeyHint: Stored encrypted. Kupro only shows the last 4 characters.
wizard.projectIdHint: Leave it empty to use your default project.
wizard.checking: Asking {{name}} which models this key can use…
wizard.routesExplain: What you tick has no hour limit, and {{name}} bills the workspace directly. If the key stops working, those parts pause: Kupro won't switch back to its own key.
wizard.live: {{name}} is live. What runs on it has no hour limit.

check.works: {{name}} accepted the key, and the models Kupro needs are available.
check.rejectedHint: Check that you copied the secret key, and paste it again.
check.unverifiedHint: Nothing runs on it until a check passes. Try again in a moment.

custom.title: Your own EU endpoint
custom.intro: Any OpenAI-compatible API, such as your own Whisper or vLLM server. Kupro sends meeting audio and text to it.
custom.name: Name
custom.keyHint: The endpoint's API key or bearer token. Stored encrypted.
custom.chat: Meeting proposals and voice commands (chat with structured output)
custom.eu: This endpoint is in the EU/EEA and run by us or our processor.
custom.euHint: Kupro keeps your name and the time with the connection. Kupro doesn't check it.
custom.movesHint: What you tick moves to this endpoint once the check passes.
custom.saved: Saved {{name}}. What you ticked runs on it now.
custom.needServes: Tick what the endpoint can run, and name the model for each.

errors.key_storage_not_configured: This server can't keep AI keys: it has no key storage. Ask whoever runs your Kupro server to set it up.
errors.endpoint_not_https: Give the endpoint's full https:// address, such as https://ai.example.eu/v1. Kupro sends meeting audio to it.
errors.endpoint_not_public: That address isn't on the public internet, so Kupro can't reach it from its servers.
errors.endpoint_not_found: That address doesn't resolve. Check the spelling.
errors.eu_confirmation_required: Confirm where the endpoint runs first.
errors.model_required: Name the model for each part you tick.
errors.ai_connection_not_found: The connection is gone. Someone may have removed it.

modeHelp.fullAuto: Clear changes apply at once and can be undone. New issues, unclear matches and cancelling still wait for you.

meeting.allowFullAuto: Allow full auto in this workspace ({{ops}})

meeting.usage: ≈ {{used}} of {{included}} meeting hours used this month

meeting.typePlaceholder: Or type what was said, e.g. “move KUP-12 to next sprint”

meeting.confirmUndoAll: Undo every change this meeting made?
meeting.summary: {{applied}} applied, {{rejected}} rejected, {{undone}} undone, {{pending}} still waiting. Waiting proposals can still be reviewed.

role.ownerHint: Everything, including members, workspace settings, export and billing.
role.memberHint: Creates and edits issues, projects, sprints, plans and meetings.

members.title: Members
members.billingHint: Can see usage and cost and manage the subscription. Combines with any role and takes no seat.
members.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {{name}}? Their access and API tokens are revoked, and so are their agents. Their name stays in the history.
members.placeholdersHint: People from an imported tracker. They can't sign in and take no seat.
members.mergeConfirm: Everything {{name}} did moves to the person you pick, and {{name}} is removed. This can't be undone.

errors.guestLimit: All free guest places are taken ({{count}} of {{limit}}, 5 per seat). Add a seat or deactivate a guest first.
errors.alreadyMember: That email is already a member or has an invite.
errors.lastOwner: A workspace needs at least one active owner. Make someone else owner first.

sprintClose.noBurndown: This sprint has no burndown: it closed before Kupro kept one.

importWizard.sourceLede: Pick a source and connect. The next steps map it, with a live dry run on the right.
importWizard.emailHint: Jira Cloud: the email of the account the API token belongs to. Data Center: leave empty and paste a personal access token.
importWizard.tokenHint: Read access is enough. Kupro encrypts it and deletes it when you finish the migration.
importWizard.behindVpn: Behind a VPN or firewall: run kupro import {{kind}} --local and upload the snapshot.
importWizard.trelloAuthorizeHint: Allow read access, then paste the token Trello shows. Once you finish the migration, you can revoke it in Trello.
importWizard.trelloNoKey: This server isn't set up to read Trello. Run kupro import trello --local --key <your Trello API key> and upload the snapshot.

drop.kupro: Drop a Kupro export .zip here or

dropHint.csv: You check its columns before the next step.
dropHint.snapshot: Made by kupro import … --local or your own script.
dropHint.kupro: Moves a whole workspace, keys and history included.

importWizard.noSource: This import reads its source with a token. Start a new import to change it.
importWizard.connectedLede: Connected. Changing the source starts a new import; this one stays as a draft.
importWizard.projectsLede: Pick what to import and the key each project gets. Item numbers stay where the source has them.
importWizard.boardLabel: Status, sprints and estimates from a GitHub project
importWizard.boardHint: Its Status sets the state of open issues, its Iteration becomes sprints, and a number field such as Estimate, Points or Size becomes the estimate. A project on a personal account needs a classic token with read:project.
importWizard.columnsLedeAsk: Kupro guessed which column is each item's state, assignee, dates and effort. Where it can't tell, it asks below: answer to go on.
importWizard.columnsLedeClear: Kupro picked which column is each item's state, assignee, dates and effort. Check each board, and change anything that looks wrong.
importWizard.columnsNothing: No column gives the state, assignee, dates or effort: items come across with their name, group and fields.
importWizard.askRest: The ones you don’t pick become fields.

ask.status: {{board}} has {{count}} status columns. Which one says how far an item has come?
ask.people: {{board}} has {{count}} people columns. Which one says who does the item?
ask.timeline: {{board}} has {{count}} timelines. Which one holds the start and due dates?
ask.date: {{board}} has {{count}} date columns. Which one is the due date?

role.dateFallback: Due date, when the timeline is empty

importWizard.hierarchyLede: The source has four levels, Kupro has three. This is a team choice with no default.
importWizard.foldLegend: Which end folds? The counts cover every project in the import.
importWizard.treePick: Pick an option above to see where these items land.
importWizard.treeLegend: Real items from the source. A highlighted note marks a new parent or type; a moved item keeps a relates link to its old parent. Hover or focus an item to find it on the other side.
importWizard.typesLede: Each source type becomes a Kupro type, or is left out. A label keeps where it came from.
importWizard.statesLede: Mapped by each state's category where the source has one. Change any row; the plan on the right updates.
importWizard.peopleLede: Matched by email first, then by name. Check the name matches; placeholders can be invited later.
importWizard.fieldsLede: Pick which fields become labels. The rest go into a details block on each issue.
importWizard.noFields: This source has no fields to map.
importWizard.effortLede: Estimates in hours come across as they are. Story points have no safe conversion, so you choose.
importWizard.hoursHint: No default: every team sizes points differently.
importWizard.noEffort: Import items with only story points without effort
importWizard.reviewLede: The dry run. Nothing is written until you import, and the import can be undone until you finish the migration.
importWizard.perPointNotSet: Hours per story point not set
importWizard.hoursAsIs: Hours from the file, as they are

warn.statusesToReview_other: {{count}} items have a state Kupro guessed. Check them under States.

warn.conflicts_other: {{count}} fields changed on both sides. Kupro keeps its values.
warn.deletedInSource_one: {{count}} imported item is gone from the source. It is left alone.
warn.deletedInSource_other: {{count}} imported items are gone from the source. They are left alone.
warn.parentLoops_one: {{count}} item is in a parent loop and becomes a top-level issue.
warn.parentLoops_other: {{count}} items are in a parent loop and become top-level issues.
warn.skippedByScope_one: {{count}} item is left out by the scope.
warn.skippedByScope_other: {{count}} items are left out by the scope.

importWizard.noWarnings: Nothing to look at: every item has a place.
importWizard.alsoCopied: Also copied: {{comments}} comments, {{changes}} history entries, {{sprints}} sprints, {{labels}} labels.
importWizard.foldBottomTrade: Top-level items stay on the delivery plan. The bottom level's grouping becomes a relates link.
importWizard.foldTopTrade: The lower levels keep their children. Top-level items leave the delivery plan and become labels.

importRun.title: Importing
importRun.lede: You can close this tab; the run continues on the server.
importRun.queued: Waiting for another run to finish

importPage.tokenRejectedText: The source refused the token. Paste a new one; the next run continues where the last one stopped.
importPage.autoSyncHint: Turns itself off after 30 days with no change on either side. You get an email when it does.
importPage.undoConfirm: Undo deletes every issue, project, label and sprint this import created. It can't be undone.
importPage.edited_one: {{n}} imported issue was edited in Kupro since: {{keys}}
importPage.edited_other: {{n}} imported issues were edited in Kupro since: {{keys}}
importPage.blocked_one: Undo is blocked: {{n}} record made outside this import points at its issues ({{list}}).
importPage.blocked_other: Undo is blocked: {{n}} records made outside this import point at its issues ({{list}}).
importPage.finishConfirm: Finishing stops syncing and deletes the token. Keys, aliases and history stay. After this, the import can't be undone.

importRuns.deleted_one: {{count}} item is gone from the source and was left alone:
importRuns.deleted_other: {{count}} items are gone from the source and were left alone:

importConflicts.lede: Someone changed these in Kupro after the last import. Kupro kept its value; the source value is shown so you can decide.
importConflicts.kept: Kept. It comes back only if the source changes again.

importPeople.lede: People an import couldn't match to a member. Invite them, or merge them into a member; their history follows.

button.idle: Talk to Kupro. Hold to talk, or hold Ctrl+Space.

status.dictating: Listening. Your words go into the field.

voice.undoFailed: Couldn’t undo: the issue was changed since. Undo it by hand.

none.nothingHeard: I didn’t hear anything. Hold the button while you talk.
none.notUnderstood: I didn’t catch a change or a place to go. Try “move KUP-12 to next sprint” or “open KUP-12”.
none.notFound: I couldn’t find that issue, person or sprint in this workspace.
none.projectNeeded: Say which project, for example “board for Kupro”.

voice.keyword: This month’s AI hours are used up, so only clear commands work.

blocked.budgetTitle: This month’s AI hours are used up
blocked.budget: The microphone is off until next month. Typing still works, and an Owner can connect the workspace’s own AI key for unlimited voice.
blocked.rejectedTitle: The AI provider rejected the workspace’s key
blocked.rejected: The microphone is off until an Owner replaces the key in the AI settings. Kupro’s included hours aren’t used meanwhile. Typing still works.
blocked.unavailableTitle: Voice isn’t set up on this server
blocked.microphone: Allow the microphone for this site in your browser, then try again.

tidy.hint: Fixes spelling and punctuation, nothing else.

settings.topBar: In the top bar, next to search

settings.autoApplyHint: Unsure matches, cancelling and new issues still ask first. Every change can be undone.

log.searchIssue: Search issues or type a key
log.savedAndClosed: Saved together: {{duration}} logged and {{key}} marked {{state}}. Its time is now locked.

week.tileGaps: Weekdays so far with no time

team.ownersOnly: Only workspace Owners see everyone’s time.

export.failed: Couldn’t export the time. Try again.

errors.time_locked: The issue is done or canceled, so its time is locked. Reopen it to change time on it.
errors.future_date: You can’t log time on a day that hasn’t happened yet.
errors.not_your_entry: Only the person whose time it is can change it.
errors.time_entry_not_found: That entry is gone. The week has been reloaded.
errors.time_registration_off: Time registration is off in this workspace. An Owner can turn it on in workspace settings.
errors.failed: Couldn’t save the time. Try again.

workspaceSettings.failed: Couldn’t save the setting. Try again.
workspaceSettings.ownersOnly: Only workspace Owners change these settings.

time.title: Time registration
time.intro: Members log the time they spend on issues. Danish employers must record working time; this is where your team does it. Off by default.
time.private: Each person sees only their own time. Owners see everyone’s and export it.
time.locked: Time on a Done or Canceled issue is locked until the issue is reopened.
time.kept: Records are kept for 5 years, also after someone leaves, and also if you turn this off.
time.turnedOff: Time registration is off. Records are kept.
